vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: comic-script
Version: 2.3.0

The skill bundle is a legitimate tool for generating comic script templates and character sheets. The core logic in `scripts/comic.sh` consists of a Python script that prints text-based templates to the console based on user input, with no evidence of network activity, file system modifications, or data exfiltration.

llm.summary: The skill's code and instructions align with its stated purpose (generating comic/storyboard templates); it has no network calls, no credentials requested, and no install steps — only a small local script that prints templates.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the included functionality (storyboard, character, dialogue, layout). Minor inconsistency: metadata lists no required binaries but scripts/comic.sh invokes python3 at runtime — the skill will fail if python3 is not available but this does not appear malicious.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the shell+Python script are narrowly scoped to producing comic/storyboard templates and tips. The instructions and script do not read other files, access environment variables, or transmit data externally.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only style) and no downloads. The only executable is scripts/comic.sh which runs embedded Python; nothing is written to disk beyond the included files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested. Runtime uses only local python3; no secrets or external service tokens are needed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request any persistent or elevated privileges or modify other skills/config. Autonomous invocation is allowed by default but the skill's behavior is limited and coherent.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it generates storyboard/character/dialogue templates locally. Note that the included script runs python3 (embedded Python) even though metadata didn't declare python3 as a required binary — ensure python3 is present if you intend to run the script. There are no network calls or credential requests. If you do not trust the unknown owner, inspect scripts/comic.sh yourself before running; otherwise it is reasonable to install and use for comic/script generation.
